Version 3, adopted by the Board January 2025. Sections 4 and 6 only.

recognised: An instrument that states its own adoption: 'Version 3, adopted by the Board January 2025'.

Contemporaneity: the adoption time is stated by the instrument, to the month; but the material is an 'extract' of 'Sections 4 and 6 only' and nothing shows it is the text as adopted rather than a later copy. Authentication: not evidenced — no adopting resolution, signature, or register entry is in the material; a Board minute of January 2025 would supply it.
